arcadia.name: Arcadia Planitia · candidate region
arcadia.description: Illustrative regional centre (40°N, 170°W), not an approved landing coordinate. NASA orbital studies identify accessible subsurface ice in Arcadia as relevant to future human exploration. Cold, dust, terrain, radiation and landing hazards still require assessment; proximity to existing rovers is not established.

gale_study.name: Gale / Mount Sharp · science reference
gale_study.description: Science reference near the Curiosity landing region, supported by NASA rover observations. Included for research proximity, not as a NASA-approved human landing site or a confirmed ice resource. Coordinates are an illustrative reference, not a habitat location.

deuteronilus.name: Deuteronilus Mensae · candidate region
deuteronilus.description: Illustrative regional reference near 41°N, 22°E, not an approved landing or habitat coordinate. NASA SWIM research identifies glacial networks in this region as matching multiple criteria for accessible subsurface ice. Terrain, cold, radiation, dust and engineering constraints remain unresolved; not near an operating rover.
